destination.title: Dark matter: candidates, origins, dynamics and tests
destination.question: Which dark-matter candidates, production histories, interactions and observational signatures are compatible with the conditions examined by each source?
destination.summary: The original numerical proposal mixes candidate construction, dynamics, searches, reviews and neighboring dark-energy questions. These support a navigable family, while purely dark-energy targets and broad research agendas require explicit alternate or overlap placement. The region and overview cards below are new scope proposals.

systems: Particle, wave, multicomponent and compact-object dark matter
regimes: Source-specific early-universe, galactic, cluster and laboratory settings
Both ordinary and conjecture-motivated work, including pre-Swampland sources
assumptions: Different sources may use different coupled fractions, production histories, interactions and dimensions
Observational compatibility refers to the source's own analysis and date
conventions: Overview membership does not establish fine-question equivalence
Extracted graph parents retain their setting, claim, quantity or assumption types
includes: Historical hypotheses retained as historical context
Neighboring cosmology questions through explicit overlap and alternate homes
excludes: A mandatory quantum-gravity premise for the family

originalIndependentAssessment.note: Retain the exact prior broad record. Its overlap and alternate placements make the family usable, including ordinary and pre-Swampland work. This does not validate an unqualified numerical boundary or establish one fine question. The original numerical proposal has no separately supplied scientific boundary prose to certify.

sources.title: A Dark-Dimension Origin of Geometric Inelastic Dark Matter: The LUX-ZEPLIN High-Recoil Event and Multi-Target Tests

evidence.text: Can distant-brane symmetry breaking generate the few-hundred-keV splitting of pseudo-Dirac electroweak dark matter motivated by the reported LZ high-recoil event, and what heavy-target tests follow?

sources.title: Fuzzy dark matter and the dark dimension

evidence.text: Can the radion of a micron-sized dark dimension be ultralight fuzzy dark matter, and can inflaton-fed KK graviton cascades supply its cosmological abundance?

sources.title: Detection of An Unidentified Emission Line in the Stacked X-ray spectrum of Galaxy Clusters

evidence.text: Can rest-frame stacking of archival galaxy-cluster X-ray spectra reveal previously unidentified weak emission lines, and can a detected feature be distinguished from thermal plasma emission, instrumental artifacts or a possible sterile-neutrino decay signal?

sources.title: The COSMIC WISPers White Paper: The physics case for Weakly Interacting Slim Particles

evidence.text: What motivates very weakly interacting sub-GeV particles, and how can cosmology, astrophysics and laboratory searches test their roles in dark matter and other unresolved phenomena?

sources.title: Boson stars and oscillatons: A review

evidence.text: What equilibrium families, formation mechanisms, stability limits, and astrophysical tests are known for bosonic compact objects, including their proposed roles as dark matter and black hole mimickers?

sources.title: Searching for the light dark gauge boson in GeV-scale experiments

evidence.text: Which low-energy experiments can constrain or discover a weakly coupled, roughly hundred-MeV to GeV dark vector, and what fixed-target designs could extend sensitivity beyond existing collider and meson-decay samples?

sources.title: Structure formation with dark magnetohydrodynamics

evidence.text: How do collective dark-plasma effects and background dark magnetic fields modify gravitational collapse, directional Jeans scales, and the linear matter power spectrum in a secluded dark sector?

sources.title: Continuum-Mediated Self-Interacting Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can exchange through a gapped, nearly conformal mediator sector generate dark matter self-interactions with non-integer velocity scaling that accommodate small-scale halo observations while satisfying cluster constraints? What Sommerfeld enhancement accompanies these interactions?

sources.title: Swampland bounds on dark sectors

evidence.text: Can quantum-gravity consistency hypotheses restrict dark particles whose masses, interactions, or abundances evade laboratory and cosmological probes? The paper treats present and inflationary de Sitter backgrounds and compares theoretical restrictions with observationally accessible dark-sector parameter spaces.

sources.title: A Mini Review of some Dark Matter/BSM Physics and a Bit More

evidence.text: Which connections between dark matter candidates, underlying BSM physics, cosmological consistency and detection strategies provide useful physical insights? This is a subjective review, including excluded or potentially excludable ideas, rather than a systematic assessment of surviving models.

sources.title: Understanding the Core-Halo Relation of Quantum Wave Dark Matter from 3D Simulations

evidence.text: How are the mass and size of a solitonic ψDM core related to its surrounding halo in the nonlinear, virialized regime, and does the same relation emerge in cosmological collapse and controlled soliton mergers?

sources.title: Dark Matter Candidates from Particle Physics and Methods of Detection

evidence.text: Which dark matter candidates motivated by particle physics problems have viable production mechanisms, and how could laboratory, collider and astrophysical observations identify them?

sources.title: The Swampland, Quintessence and the Vacuum Energy

evidence.text: Could a rolling modulus interact primarily with dark matter while satisfying restrictions on Standard Model parameter changes and long-range forces?

sources.title: Dark Photon Dark Matter from a Network of Cosmic Strings

evidence.text: Can a cosmic string network formed by the same symmetry breaking that generates a dark photon mass produce the observed abundance of ultralight, nonrelativistic vector dark matter?

sources.title: Rescuing Massive Photons from the Swampland

evidence.text: Can inflationary fluctuations produce all dark matter as a light vector while its scalar partners and ultraviolet cutoff remain above the inflationary Hubble scale?

sources.title: Exotic PeVatrons as sources of ultra-high-energy gamma rays

evidence.text: Could rotating exotic compact objects coupled to millicharged dark matter power Galactic gamma-ray sources beyond PeV energies, and could spin-dependent emission or gravitational waves distinguish their proposed classes?

sources.title: Unidentified Line in X-Ray Spectra of the Andromeda Galaxy and Perseus Galaxy Cluster

evidence.text: Does an unidentified weak X-ray feature occur at a common rest-frame energy in M31 and Perseus, and are its redshift, spatial distribution and relative brightness compatible with dark-matter decay rather than instrumental or atomic emission?

sources.title: Dark-Matter Decays and Self-Gravitating Halos

evidence.text: How do small-recoil dark-matter decays change self-gravitating halo masses and density profiles, and what lifetime–kick-speed constraints follow from halo concentrations and galaxy-cluster abundances?

sources.title: Ultralight fermionic dark matter

evidence.text: Can many distinct, nearly degenerate fermionic species constitute ultralight dark matter while evading the single-species Tremaine-Gunn bound, and what gravitational production, cosmological, and black-hole constraints limit their number?

sources.title: Testing String Theory with Combined Cosmological Probes: A Case Study for Dark Matter Gravitons

evidence.text: How tightly can combined CMB and BAO observations constrain Dark Dimension graviton dark matter, what sensitivity could future tomographic surveys achieve, and what nonlinear modelling is needed to make those tests reliable?

sources.title: Probing For Non-Gravitational Galactic-Range Dark Matter Interactions

evidence.text: Does Milky Way dark matter produce a non-gravitational, galactic-range acceleration that differs between beryllium and aluminum? The experiment also tests composition independence of acceleration toward dark matter.

sources.title: Ultralight scalars as cosmological dark matter

evidence.text: Can ultralight bosonic dark matter preserve successful large-scale cosmology while changing small-scale structure and galactic dynamics? The paper combines a review of fuzzy dark matter (FDM) with new calculations and proposed observational tests.

sources.title: Probing New Physics with Multi-messenger Astronomy

evidence.text: How can complementary photon, cosmic-ray, neutrino and gravitational-wave observations constrain heavy decaying dark matter, pseudo-Dirac neutrinos and light dark-sector particles, using astrophysical neutrino sources and GW170817 as examples?

sources.title: Non-Abelian dark matter and dark radiation

evidence.text: Can WIMP dark matter charged under a very weak non-Abelian gauge group produce distinctive particle-search signals, interacting dark radiation and smooth suppression of structure?

sources.title: Snowmass Theory Frontier: Astrophysics and Cosmology

evidence.text: Which theoretical advances enable searches for dark matter and early-universe physics, improve cosmological inference, and connect observations to fundamental theory? What work should receive priority over the following decade?

sources.title: Dark matter self-interactions via collisionless shocks in cluster mergers

evidence.text: Can collective plasma effects make a subdominant charged dark-matter component effectively collisional in cluster mergers, despite negligible binary scattering, while allowing thermal production and compatibility with the cosmological constraints considered?

sources.title: Hidden Charged Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can exact hidden charge conservation stabilize thermal dark matter while satisfying relic-abundance, small-scale structure, enhanced-annihilation and halo self-interaction constraints?

sources.title: Higher spin dark matter

evidence.text: Can gravitational production during inflation supply all dark matter as massive bosonic particles with spin greater than two, and can directional nuclear recoils reveal their spin?

sources.title: Hubble sinks in the low-redshift swampland

evidence.text: Can dark-matter coupling produce apparent phantom dark energy while the scalar remains canonical? The adopted present normalization fixes a nonphantom effective value today, while evolution at positive redshift can change that behavior.

sources.title: Report of the Topical Group on Cosmic Probes of Fundamental Physics for for Snowmass 2021

evidence.text: How can cosmic particles and gravitational waves probe cosmological tensions, neutrino properties, early-Universe physics and dark matter beyond laboratory reach?

sources.title: Wave Dark Matter

evidence.text: What dynamics and observable signatures follow when bosonic dark matter has sufficiently high phase-space occupancy to behave as classical waves, and how can astrophysical observations and axion experiments test those signatures?

sources.title: Dynamical Dark Matter: I. Theoretical Overview

evidence.text: Can a large ensemble of unstable dark-matter components remain cosmologically viable by balancing shorter lifetimes against smaller abundances, and can a Kaluza–Klein tower naturally realize this balance?

sources.title: New Limits on Charged Dark Matter from Large-Scale Coherent Magnetic Fields

evidence.text: Can cumulative angular-momentum transfer from a rotating, magnetized galactic ISM to a more slowly rotating charged dark-matter halo constrain the dark-matter charge-to-mass ratio through the absence of severe gas-disk contraction?

sources.title: Double-Disk Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can a subdominant interacting dark-matter component satisfy the paper's observational bounds, dissipate energy into a galactic disk and produce distinguishable gravitational or particle-detection signatures?

sources.title: Landscape, Swampland, and Extra Dimensions

evidence.text: Can the small dark-energy density be understood through an infinite-distance decompactification limit with one micron-scale dark dimension, while accommodating dark matter, neutrino masses and cosmology?

sources.title: Cold and fuzzy dark matter

evidence.text: Can free, ultralight scalar dark matter suppress dwarf-scale cusps and excessive low-mass halo formation through its wave properties, while retaining the large-scale benefits of cold dark matter?

sources.title: The NANOGrav 15 yr Data Set: Search for Signals from New Physics

evidence.text: Do ultralight dark matter or Galactic dark-matter substructures produce detectable deterministic timing signals?

sources.title: Checking the Dark Matter Origin of a 3.53 keV Line with the Milky Way Center

evidence.text: Is the Galactic Center spectrum consistent with a dark-matter decay interpretation of previously reported approximately 3.53 keV signals? The paper frames the test through both a minimum expected GC flux from other detections and a maximum allowed flux from Milky Way blank-sky non-detection.

sources.title: Do neutrinos bend? Consequences of an ultralight gauge field as dark matter

evidence.text: Can transverse modes of ultralight vector dark matter bend neutrinos crossing the Galactic core, producing direction-dependent delays measurable against electromagnetic or gravitational-wave signals?

sources.title: Dark matter candidates and searches

evidence.text: What could dark matter be, how could its abundance have arisen, and how do laboratory, astrophysical, and collider searches constrain the leading proposals?

sources.title: A new constraint on millicharged dark matter from galaxy clusters

evidence.text: Can preservation of observed, gravity-dominated galaxy-cluster dark-matter profiles constrain a small dark-matter electric charge through the effects of cluster magnetic fields?

sources.title: Dark sector tunneling field potentials for a dark big bang

evidence.text: Which parameters of a quartic dark-sector tunnelling potential permit a Dark Big Bang under the cosmological bounds adopted in the paper, and can the newly identified parameter region produce all dark matter with observable gravitational-wave signatures?

sources.title: Cosmic Structure as the Quantum Interference of a Coherent Dark Wave

evidence.text: Can coherent, nonrelativistic bosonic dark matter retain successful large-scale structure while producing dwarf-galaxy cores and suppressing small haloes, and can stellar dynamics constrain its boson mass?

sources.title: Exacerbating the cosmological constant problem with interacting dark energy models

evidence.text: How severely do cosmologically varying dark-matter masses worsen vacuum-energy fine-tuning, and could observations of interacting dark energy challenge anthropic explanations based on a finite ensemble of vacua?

sources.title: Millicharge or Decay: A Critical Take on Minimal Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can Minimal Dark Matter remain viable when electric neutrality or a Planck-scale cutoff is relaxed, and what relic-abundance and gamma-ray signatures follow?

sources.title: Direct Detection of Dark Photon Dark Matter Using Radio Telescopes

evidence.text: Can local absorption of kinetically mixed ultralight dark-photon dark matter by existing radio-telescope antennas provide direct constraints, and how do dish geometry and spatial coherence determine future array sensitivity?

sources.title: Milky Way Satellite Census. IV. Constraints on Decaying Dark Matter from Observations of Milky Way Satellite Galaxies

evidence.text: What bounds on late-time two-body dark matter decay follow from the abundance and observed properties of Milky Way satellites, after accounting for survey selection and uncertainties in the galaxy–halo connection?

sources.title: Dark Matter

evidence.text: What observations support dark matter, what can constitute it, how might it be produced, and how can astrophysical, laboratory and collider searches constrain its properties?

sources.title: Snowmass Cosmic Frontier Report

evidence.text: Which cosmic observations and complementary searches can identify dark matter and its origin, distinguish dark energy from modified gravity, determine inflationary dynamics and energy scale, constrain neutrino masses, and discover new particles or interactions?

sources.title: Cold dark matter: controversies on small scales

evidence.text: Can baryonic galaxy-formation physics resolve the central-density and satellite discrepancies of collisionless CDM simulations, or do these discrepancies require different dark-matter properties?

sources.title: Early dark sector, the Hubble tension, and the swampland

evidence.text: Can cosmological bounds on a scalar-dependent dark-matter mass challenge an SDC-motivated early-dark-energy model when the fraction of coupled matter is not fixed by the conjecture?

sources.title: Does the fraction of dark matter diminish with early dark energy?

evidence.text: Can a limited dark-matter component change mass during EDE evolution while the remaining matter retains constant mass?

sources.title: Dark Matter and Dark Radiation

evidence.text: Can dark matter carry an unbroken long-range U(1)D interaction while satisfying thermal-relic, radiation-density and galactic-dynamics constraints, and could the resulting neutral dark plasma have observable collective effects?

sources.title: Compact objects and the swampland

evidence.text: Can a boson star lower its energy by dispersing or fragmenting into scalar particles? The source uses its mass–charge comparison as a sufficient energetic-instability test.

sources.title: Compact objects and the swampland

evidence.text: How can elementary scalar particles support boson stars of astrophysical mass? The reviewed free-field scaling motivates ultralight particles, while quartic interactions are introduced to permit much larger stellar masses for heavier bosons.

sources.title: Two Micron‐Size Dark Dimensions

evidence.text: Under what conditions can two compact dimensions of micron size, with species scale near 10 TeV, satisfy collider, astrophysical and cosmological constraints and support dark-matter candidates?

sources.title: Dark matter interpretation of the ANITA anomalous events

evidence.text: Can Galactic dark matter decaying into highly boosted right-handed neutrinos quantitatively account for the historical ANITA upward-going events, while satisfying propagation and cosmological constraints and predicting complementary IceCube signals?

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: Can a decreasing exchanged-scalar mass increase dark-matter scattering without appreciably varying the dark-matter mass?

sources.title: Towards a direct detection of the spin of dark matter

evidence.text: For selected higher-spin dark-matter interactions, can polarized directional nuclear recoils distinguish integer from half-integer spin and determine the spin magnitude? What correlated recoil pattern could arise from a supersymmetric higher-spin dark sector?

sources.title: Probing Dynamics of Boson Stars by Fast Radio Bursts and Gravitational Wave Detection

evidence.text: Can a very light scalar have a sufficiently small primordial displacement and later constitute a fraction of dark matter in boson stars?

sources.title: Constraints on millicharged dark matter and axionlike particles from timing of radio waves

evidence.text: Can dispersion of radio pulses and time variation of their polarization constrain millicharged dark matter and ultralight axion-like dark matter through their effects during propagation?

sources.title: Astrophysical plasma instabilities induced by long-range interacting dark matter

evidence.text: Can collective plasma streaming instabilities constrain millicharged or dark-U(1)-charged dark matter more strongly than particle collisions in cosmological systems, and change existing galactic disk spin-down constraints?

sources.title: Super-resonant dark matter

evidence.text: Can approximately supersymmetric dark QCD naturally generate the exceptionally small resonance splitting needed for velocity-dependent dark-matter self-interactions, fit the adopted dwarf-to-cluster halo constraints, and produce the relic abundance?

sources.title: On the cosmological abundance of magnetic monopoles

evidence.text: Can astrophysical magnetic fields constrain cosmological monopole abundance through Debye shielding, and what electromagnetic and gravitational bounds remain on nonrelativistic monopoles, including monopole dark matter?

sources.title: Gravitino Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can noncatastrophic gravitino production explain dark matter, and can the GSC be related to other proposed quantum-gravity constraints? The paper develops neither an abundance calculation nor an implication involving the GSC.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Can an ultralight scalar preserve successful large-scale dark-matter behavior while altering small-scale structure? The supplied text identifies a 10⁻²²–10⁻²¹ eV mass range but ends before explaining the mechanism or connecting it quantitatively to wormholes.

sources.title: Subaru-HSC through a different lens: Microlensing by extended dark matter structures

evidence.text: How do simultaneous finite lens and source sizes change microlensing magnification and Subaru-HSC constraints on extended dark matter populations, particularly NFW subhalos and boson stars at asteroid-to-Earth masses?

sources.title: Probing Dynamics of Boson Stars by Fast Radio Bursts and Gravitational Wave Detection

evidence.text: Do selected boson-star configurations satisfy the adopted field-range and potential-gradient conjectures?

sources.title: Violation of the equivalence principle from light scalar dark matter

evidence.text: What local clock-comparison and differential-acceleration signatures arise when light scalar dark matter couples linearly or quadratically to Standard Model sectors, and what coupling limits follow from the existing measurements used in this 2018 analysis?

sources.title: Phenomenology of nuclear scattering for a WIMP of arbitrary spin

evidence.text: How do arbitrary-spin WIMP operators change direct-detection constraints, target preferences and recoil spectra, and how much could higher-energy searches improve sensitivity? The quantitative study activates separately the 44 couplings available for jχ≤2.

sources.title: Cosmological stasis and the coupled dark sector of the Dark Dimension

evidence.text: Can scalar-dependent dark matter masses sustain cosmological stasis, which potentials permit it, and can its lifetimes, exits or future capture be compatible with the observed universe?

destination.title: De Sitter quantum descriptions, entropy and dynamics
destination.question: How can de Sitter and explicitly related cosmological systems be described and measured, and what do their field dynamics, horizon entropy and consistency tests establish under specified assumptions?
destination.summary: This is a new parent proposal spanning quantum descriptions, observer access, entropy, field and state dynamics, and effective-theory tests. Numerical ancestry supplies provenance rather than scientific equivalence. The overlapping child batches need not become separate public branches.

systems: Pure, asymptotically and approximately de Sitter geometries and static patches
Quantum fields, proposed quantum-gravity descriptions and coherent or excited states
De Sitter-sliced geometries, without identifying their bulk with a de Sitter vacuum
Inflationary and closed cosmological settings as explicitly qualified extensions
targets: Quantum descriptions, boundary conditions and observable access
Horizon entropy, entanglement and proposed microscopic accounts
Field correlations, transitions, state validity and backreaction
regimes: Classical geometry, fixed-background QFT and semiclassical gravity
Proposed perturbative and nonperturbative quantum descriptions
Stationary, evolving, temporary and asymptotic settings
Source-specific bulk, slice and reduction dimensions
assumptions: Finite entropy, finite state-space dimension and an entropy ceiling are separate propositions
Framework, state, observer, boundary and tracing choices remain source-specific
Neither a common Swampland premise nor a universal stability conclusion is imposed
Child-ledger support is attributed evidence, not a fresh verification of every descendant
conventions: Preserve global, static-patch, asymptotic and observer-accessible distinctions
Preserve source-specific dimensional, scalar-potential and entropy conventions
Retain dated conjectures and obstacles as historical context
includes: Cross-batch routes through existing scoped questions
Method and alternate-home links for general conditioning and QFT questions
excludes: Question identity inferred from numerical ancestry or a common method
A universal de Sitter exclusion, instability or finite-dimensionality theorem
Automatic promotion of fixed-background effects to geometric backreaction
Admission of pending child replacements through parent inclusion
Automatic core membership for general observer-conditioning or non-de Sitter QFT

sources.title: Thermal derivation of the Coleman-De Luccia tunneling prescription

evidence.text: Determine a decay rate and post-transition initial conditions from a thermal scalar theory confined to a de Sitter causal diamond. The central issue is whether the usual Euclidean prescription requires information outside the observer's horizon.

sources.title: The IR stability of de Sitter QFT: results at all orders

evidence.text: Is the interacting Hartle-Hawking state of massive scalar QFT in de Sitter space perturbatively well defined and infrared stable, with connected N-point functions decaying at large separation at every perturbative order?

sources.title: Quantum instability of the de Sitter space

evidence.text: Can interacting quantum fields destabilize fixed de Sitter backgrounds through particle production, infrared divergences and noncommuting UV/IR limits, allowing symmetry breaking and large backreaction?

sources.title: de Sitter Space as a Resonance

evidence.text: Can metastable de Sitter space receive a potentially rigorous quantum definition as a resonance in transition amplitudes between particular excited states of asymptotically supersymmetric flat vacua? The diagnostic is a pole in a spectral representation of such an amplitude.

sources.title: Quantum Break-Time of de Sitter

evidence.text: Can resolving a classical de Sitter background as a quantum coherent state expose cumulative corrections absent from a fixed-background semiclassical treatment, and estimate when its classical metric description fails?

sources.title: De Sitter Stability and Coarse Graining

evidence.text: Does de Sitter space remain self-consistent under semiclassical back reaction when the gravitational source is calculated after tracing over states beyond a local observer’s cosmological event horizon?

sources.title: Supersymmetric dS/CFT

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric Euclidean vector models define a well-behaved Hartle-Hawking wavefunction through dS/CFT, providing evidence for stable supersymmetric de Sitter space in higher-spin gravity?

sources.title: On the de Sitter swampland criterion

evidence.text: Which constant-scalar configurations of a four-dimensional gravitational potential describe de Sitter, Minkowski, or anti-de Sitter spacetime? In the paper's action convention, extrema satisfy R4 = 2V and have cosmological constant Λ = V/2.

sources.title: Entropy, Entanglement and Swampland Bounds in DS/dS

evidence.text: DS/dS proposes that gravity in a D-dimensional de Sitter bulk is described by two cutoff CFTs coupled to gravity on a d = D − 1 de Sitter slice.

sources.title: Back(reaction) to the Future in the Unruh-de Sitter State

evidence.text: Can an asymmetric de Sitter analogue of the black-hole Unruh state be physically admissible, and what stress tensor and semiclassical backreaction would it produce?

sources.title: Schottky Anomaly of deSitter Black Holes

evidence.text: What does Schottky-type behavior in Schwarzschild–de Sitter thermodynamics reveal about possible microscopic degrees of freedom, and how far can constrained spin systems and quantum particle-production results capture its two-temperature, non-equilibrium character?

sources.title: Thermodynamic interpretation of the de Sitter swampland conjecture

evidence.text: How does a changing scalar potential affect the energy density and horizon entropy of an approximately de Sitter cosmological region?

sources.title: Festina Lente: EFT Constraints from Charged Black Hole Evaporation in de Sitter

evidence.text: Must every black-hole perturbation of a long-lived de Sitter static patch eventually equilibrate back to empty de Sitter?

sources.title: Distance Conjecture and De-Sitter Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: The classical Einstein–scalar system determines how a radial scalar deformation changes the de Sitter-sliced geometry and its entropy integrals. The explicit example sets the scalar potential to zero in four bulk dimensions.

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: How does a small localized mass perturb the horizons of a de Sitter observer? The setting uses the two positive roots of the static Schwarzschild–de Sitter geometry.

sources.title: Unruh-DeWitt detector responses for complex scalar fields in de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: What response does a comoving pointlike Unruh–DeWitt detector have when quadratically coupled to a complex scalar in de Sitter spacetime, and how do regularization, massless minimal coupling, and α-vacuum choice affect its interpretation?

sources.title: Baby Universes, Holography, and the Swampland

evidence.text: How can the absence of exact compact bulk insertions coexist with local experiments? The paper retains approximate code-subspace locality and dynamical, relational observers, while assigning exact observables to asymptotic data rather than external compact probes.

sources.title: Quantum de Sitter horizon entropy from quasicanonical bulk, edge, sphere and topological string partition functions

evidence.text: How can exact quantum corrections to de Sitter horizon entropy be computed for general gravitational EFT spectra, organized into bulk and edge contributions, and used to constrain proposed microscopic entropies?

sources.title: De Sitter quantum breaking, swampland conjectures and thermal strings

evidence.text: Can semiclassical thermal backreaction be promoted to a quantum-gravity restriction on de Sitter lifetimes? The paper treats this promotion, and transfer of flat-space thermal scaling to curved backgrounds, as premises of its censorship argument.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Can stable de Sitter solutions belong to a consistent quantum theory of gravity? The source motivates its entropy study through qualitative conjectures about scalar-potential slopes or negative mass squared.

sources.title: Spiky strings in de Sitter space

evidence.text: How do de Sitter acceleration and its cosmological horizon modify semiclassical folded and spiky string Regge trajectories, their compatibility with the Higuchi bound and their ability to supply arbitrarily high spins?

sources.title: Information paradox and its resolution in de Sitter holography

evidence.text: Can entanglement islands resolve unbounded semiclassical subregion-entropy growth in de Sitter space, producing a time-dependent Page curve while retaining a massless graviton?

sources.title: Implication of the swampland distance conjecture on the Cohen–Kaplan–Nelson bound in de Sitter space

evidence.text: How does nonvacuum matter change an initially de Sitter cosmological horizon when the same energy is compared with a Schwarzschild–de Sitter black hole?

sources.title: de Sitter space as a BRST invariant coherent state of gravitons

evidence.text: Can de Sitter geometry be represented by a BRST-invariant graviton coherent state over Minkowski, and can that construction capture particle creation within controlled limits?

sources.title: Islands in closed and open universes

evidence.text: How does positive or negative spatial curvature change the existence, size, and location of cosmological entanglement islands, when thermal radiation is purified by a reference spacetime?

sources.title: Logarithmic corrections, entanglement entropy, and UV cutoffs in de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: Can a conformal description of the cosmological horizon explain de Sitter entanglement entropy, its logarithmic corrections and UV regulator, and the proposed finite dimension of an observer's Hilbert space?

sources.title: Resurgence of a de Sitter Glauber-Sudarshan State: Nodal Diagrams and Borel Resummation

evidence.text: Can nodal-diagram path integrals and generalized Borel resummation determine quantum corrections to a four-dimensional de Sitter Glauber-Sudarshan state, including its cosmological constant and displacement from the interacting vacuum?

sources.title: Resurgence of a de Sitter Glauber-Sudarshan State: Nodal Diagrams and Borel Resummation

evidence.text: Can de Sitter geometry coexist with a Wilsonian low-energy construction when its fluctuation frequencies and potentially its massive spectra vary with time?

sources.title: Entanglement, Observers and Cosmology: a view from von Neumann Algebras

evidence.text: What physical information is carried by finite type II entanglement fluctuations obtained by adding a quantum observer/reference frame, when G_N=0 or N=∞? The applications concern inflationary scalar fluctuations and the high-temperature large-N Yang–Mills phase.

sources.title: Algebras, regions, and observers.

evidence.text: Can the algebra accessible along an observer's timelike worldline replace region-based observable algebras when gravity makes regions fluctuate, and what does explicitly including an observer imply for de Sitter observables and entropy?

sources.title: Thermal derivation of the Coleman-De Luccia tunneling prescription

evidence.text: Optimize a fixed-energy escape path, convert it into a Euclidean trajectory, and extract its exit turning configuration. In a field theory the optimization takes place over spatial configurations, including gradient energy, rather than over homogeneous field values alone.

sources.title: The IR stability of de Sitter QFT: results at all orders

evidence.text: Pauli-Villars propagators add heavy principal-series fields with coefficients canceling coincident ultraviolet singularities. Extra subtractions can provide the differentiability needed for derivative couplings and field-renormalization counterterms.

sources.title: Quantum instability of the de Sitter space

evidence.text: Schwinger–Keldysh in/in diagrams, self-energy insertions and overlap integrals of Hankel modes extract infrared and secular corrections. The leading-log resummation is approached through a kinetic/Dyson ansatz.

sources.title: de Sitter Space as a Resonance

evidence.text: Constrained instantons deform the tensionless CDL geometry by separating the two nucleation events. The constraint fixes their proper-time separation along ψ=0. These deformed geometries are off shell relative to the original CDL equations; a minisuperspace integral over their separation supplies the leading contribution.

sources.title: Quantum Break-Time of de Sitter

evidence.text: Finite-time S-matrix amplitudes describe interactions of background constituents with external particles. The semiclassical subset keeps the background state unchanged. Particle-production rates use coherent-state overlaps and phase space; thermal-like high-energy suppression is estimated using cited multigraviton amplitudes and Stirling counting.

sources.title: De Sitter Stability and Coarse Graining

evidence.text: Uses adiabatic subtraction for the non-interacting theory, transforms the stress tensor into FLRW coordinates, and isolates the finite state-dependent contribution. The near-center four-dimensional energy density receives an explicit calculation in Appendix B.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography
